sloka: नैवं तेषां गतिर्भीमा न तेजो न पराक्रमः ।न मतिर्न बलोत्साहौ न रूपपरिकल्पनम् ।। ५.४६.११।।।।
transliteration: naivaṁ teṣāṁ gatirbhīmā na tejo na parākramaḥ ।na matirna balotsāhau na rūpaparikalpanam ।। 5.46.11।।।।

translations.english: "Earlier I have seen monkeys of immense prowess, like Vali and Sugriva as well as Jambavan, the bear. Also I have seen the army general, Nila, Dvivida and others. They do not have such tremendous splendour or movement valour, intellect and strength and energy. They did not have such ability to change form at their will.
translations.hindi: है वानर ! यदि तुम सब हाल ठीक-ठीक बतला दोगे, तो तुम भ्रभी छुड़वा दिए जाधोगे श्लौर यदि झूठ बोले तो जान से मरवा दिए, बाप्नोगे
